➜ Cultural Topic - La Feria
Most Spanish speaking countries celebrate regional “ferias” or fairs. Historically they were a method of exchange and market for agricultural or livestock seasons. They usually include food, music, entertainment, religious and artisanal aspects. They are bright, colorful and typically run for several days

➜ CULTURAL TOPIC - Naranjas
In Spanish culture, small portions of the backyard/land are designated for vegetable and fruit patches
column2:
these are known as huertos. They are culturally symbolic and practical in homes. Such things as providing year-round food or shade in mostly desert-like areas, as found in places like Spain or Mexico. They are a source for gathering and tradition.

∞ Video Link: [Cuidados de Naranja](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BaNRNPUziog) (with a grandmother from Spain). The video is in Spanish but enjoy watching her explain her backyard orange tree. Maybe you will pick up some words.
